content:
Lina (Design): quick note from usability session — on narrow landscape the left sidebar compresses and status chips (healthy/warning) get clipped; users cant tap the tiny chip. Screenshot attached.
Omar (Frontend): thanks. is the issue only when the console width <520?
Priya (PM): seen on Pixel Fold landscape and small tablets. breakpoint looks like ~540. main asks: keep status visible and tappable, avoid forcing horizontal scroll, and keep primary nav reachable.
Lina (Design): suggestion: collapse sidebar to icon-only at <=560 and show status chips inline in each row (left of text) with min 44px hit area; add overflow menu per-row for secondary actions.
Kai (QA): repro: simulate foldable, rotate, check safe-area insets; add hit-target test. Ticket RF-4999.
Omar (Frontend): plan: icon-only sidebar + stacked rows at <=560; move chips into row header; CSS-first approach, small JS for moving actions into disclosure. estimate 2 dev days + QA.
Priya (PM): sounds good. Lina pls update comps and copy for the disclosure label (use "Actions"). Omar add a feature flag so we can stage rollout.
ui-bot: design upload: https://assets.redwood.internal/designs/narrow-sidebar-iconmode.png
Lina (Design): thanks — will drop updated figma notes. Closing unless QA finds regressions. :white_check_mark:
